title: NF-κB Transcriptional Activity Assay using NKL reporter cells
protocol: Plate 0.5X10^6 293TN cells/well into a 6-well plate with 2ml of DMEM (10% FBS).
Incubate the plated cells overnight in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Mix OptiMEM 150μl and XtremeGENE9 6μl by flicking, then incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add pGreenFire-NF-κB-EF1-Puro 1.67μg and pPACKH1 1.67μg to the transfection mix, flick to combine, and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the transfection mix dropwise into the medium with cultured 293TN cells.
Incubate for 18 hours in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Change the medium to 2.5ml DMEM (10% FBS, 11mg/ml BSA).
Incubate for 24 hours in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Harvest 2ml of supernatant and store at 4°C.
Add another 2.5ml DMEM (10% FBS, 11mg/ml BSA) to the cells.
Incubate for an additional 24 hours in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Harvest 2ml of supernatant and combine with the first harvest.
Centrifuge the virus-containing supernatant pool at 1250rpm for 5 minutes to exclude debris.
Add 10μg/ml polybrene and 200U/ml recombinant human IL-2 to the virus-supernatant.
Resuspend 0.5X10^6 NKL cells in 2ml of virus-supernatant, transfer to a 12-well plate, and incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C CO₂.
Seal the plate with parafilm and centrifuge at 700g for 30 minutes at 32°C.
Remove parafilm and incubate for 3 hours in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Seal the plate with parafilm.
Centrifuge the plate at 700g for 30 minutes at 32°C.
Remove the parafilm from the plate.
Incubate the plate for 4 hours in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Centrifuge the cells at 1400rpm for 5 minutes to remove the supernatant.
Resuspend transduced NKL cells with 10ml of NKL culture medium (RPMI1640, 10% FBS, 1mM sodium pyruvate, 200U/ml IL-2).
Transfer the cell suspension to a T25 flask.
Incubate the flask in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Add 1μg/ml puromycin at 2 days after infection.
Centrifuge cells at 1400rpm for 5 minutes and resuspend with 10ml of NKL culture medium containing 1μg/ml puromycin at 3 days after infection.
Transfer the cell suspension to a T25 flask.
Maintain transduced cells with NKL culture medium containing 1μg/ml puromycin, splitting cells every 3 days.
Prepare 5μg/ml stimulating antibodies specific for NK receptors in PBS.
Pipette 100μl/well into a flat-bottom high-binding 96-well plate.
Cover the plate with sealing tape.
Incubate the plate overnight at room temperature.
Resuspend NKL cells rested for 24 hours in NKL resting medium (RPMI1640, 5% FBS, 0.5mM sodium pyruvate) following a 2-day culture after splitting with NKL resting medium at 2X10^6 cells/ml.
Empty the contents of the plate.
Wash wells three times with 240μl/well of PBS.
Pipette resuspended NKL cells 100 μl/well into antibody-immobilized plate.
Cover plate with lid.
Incubate for 6 hours in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Place the plate on ice.
Harvest cells from each well and transfer them into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Place 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes on ice.
Add 500 μl/sample of FACS buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 200 μl of FACS buffer.
Analyze the upregulation of GFP with FACS Accuri.
